decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (P144, P143, P142, P141, P110, P134, P133, P132, P131, P115, P130, P140, Design and Access Statement, Plant Noise Assessment received: 10/05/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The proposal shall not be brought into operation until details of a visual timber screen to be installed around the plant hereby approved the proposed have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The submission shall include the materials to be used in the screening and proposed elevations and the details so approved shall be installed before the equipment is first brought into operation and shall retained permanently thereafter.

Condition : 4 - No installation or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 08:00 to 18:00 on Mondays to Friday and 09:00 to 13:00 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The proposal shall be in full compliance with submitted Plant Noise Assessment Plan.
description: Installation of heating and roof top ventilation plant with some screening to the school
